signal: Butlr drew a follow-on investment from Ricoh's Innovation Fund in April 2026, shipped its Heatic Wired sensor, and expanded into corporate lab spaces as demand surges for anonymous occupancy data.

email.body1:
Yolanda, saw Butlr take a follow-on from Ricoh and expand into corporate labs as occupancy-data demand surges.

Growth across new segments usually means signals pile up faster than the team can act on them, and the lag between an account going in-market and a rep reaching out is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, followed-up outreach on its own: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a signal play for Butlr off your product and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Yolanda, quick follow-up for Butlr.

As you push into new verticals, the bottleneck for most RevOps teams is not data, it is the time between a signal firing and a personalized touch. That latency is measurable, and it usually shows up as slipping reply rates.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Yolanda, last bit of proof for Butlr.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Butlr's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Yolanda, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Pushing into new segments is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I will tailor it to Butlr either way.
